name: Diwali (Deepavali)
description: The Festival of Lights. Gold and warm amber tones to celebrate the victory of light over darkness.

name: Holi
description: The Festival of Colors. Vibrant pink and purple to capture the joyful spirit of gulal.

name: Republic Day
description: National Holiday (Jan 26). Saffron and India Green inspired by the Tricolour.

name: Independence Day
description: National Holiday (Aug 15). Saffron and India Green inspired by the Tricolour.

name: Makar Sankranti
description: Harvest festival of kites and sesame sweets. Sky blue meets golden yellow.

name: Navratri / Durga Puja
description: Nine nights of devotion to Goddess Durga. Crimson red and festive gold.

name: Dussehra (Vijayadashami)
description: Victory of good over evil. Bold vermillion and bright gold.

name: Ganesh Chaturthi
description: Celebrating the birth of Lord Ganesha. Marigold orange meets leaf green.

name: Krishna Janmashtami
description: Celebrating the birth of Lord Krishna. Royal blue and golden yellow.

name: Raksha Bandhan
description: The bond between brothers and sisters. Pink and teal for love and trust.

name: Pongal / Lohri / Bihu
description: Harvest festivals from across India. Earthy turmeric yellow and green.

name: Onam
description: The harvest festival of Kerala. Lush green and warm gold of the Pookalam.

name: Baisakhi / Vishu
description: Spring harvest festival. Bright saffron and deep green of the mustard fields.

name: Eid al-Fitr / Eid al-Adha
description: Major Islamic festivals of joy and gratitude. Emerald green and gleaming gold.

name: Christmas
description: Season of joy and giving. Classic festive red and crisp winter green.

name: New Year
description: Ring in the New Year! Elegant midnight black and sparkling gold.

name: Maha Shivaratri
description: The Great Night of Shiva. Deep midnight blue and sacred saffron.

name: Ugadi / Gudi Padwa
description: Telugu and Marathi New Year. Fresh spring green and bright turmeric.

name: Monsoon Season
description: The life-giving rains of India. Deep stormy slate and cool aqua.

name: Winter Season
description: Cold, cozy winter vibes. Icy navy and frosted silver.
